body:
## What it does

Takes a web app from nothing to shipped across the whole stack, with enough interface taste that the result does not look like scaffolding. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer. The taste claim is the differentiator here: plenty of bots will produce a working app, and far fewer produce one you would put in front of a user.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @TomZarebczan shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
